capabilities: Track Flowmodoro count-up focus sessions and earned breaks in the status bar
Anchor the active note, heading, and cursor position to a local state file
Create, edit, and delete RAM-dump working-memory save-states
Capture stray impulses to an impulses file without leaving the note
Run an evening shutdown ritual that parks a summary and tomorrow's first step
extras: Desktop-only (Linux, macOS, Windows); makes zero network requests and writes only to the local Tether state directory. Scientific rationale is in a separate RESEARCH.md, and the README includes a Norwegian summary. Not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
motivation: The README says traditional productivity timers fail knowledge workers and neurodivergent minds by shattering hyperfocus, causing initiation paralysis, and losing context on switches.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in focus timer, and fixed countdown Pomodoro timers break hyperfocus and lose the note, heading, and cursor context when a session ends.

relations.evidence: Seamlessly integrated with Tether Desktop, tether.nvim, and tether-vscode.
